# CodexMeter 2.0.6
Follow-up fixes from a review of the new Providers pane.
## What changed
- **The Providers pane no longer stutters.** It was reading each provider's borrowed account — for Cursor and a few others, opening a file or a SQLite database — on every redraw. Those reads are cached now and refreshed on a fetch, not on a render. - **Provider rows keep a stable order** rather than occasionally reshuffling the ones you have not dragged. - **Toggling an alert mute, or dragging a provider, no longer starts a Codex-limits network fetch.** The limits poll only restarts when the account-limits setting itself changes.
## Verification
- 594 automated tests, 0 failures (9 environment-integration tests skipped). - `swift build` with zero warnings and zero errors. - Universal 2 build for Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later. - Ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. SHA-256 protects the first download; Sparkle authenticates later updates with Ed25519 signatures.
## Install or update with Homebrew
```bash brew update brew upgrade --cask --greedy dlfkdLR/tap/codexmeter ```
```bash xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/CodexMeter.app open /Applications/CodexMeter.app ```
## First direct-download launch
Download `CodexMeter-2.0.6.dmg` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` into the same folder and verify the checksum before opening:
```bash cd ~/Downloads grep ' CodexMeter-2.0.6.dmg$' SHA256SUMS.txt | shasum -a 256 -c - open CodexMeter-2.0.6.dmg ```
## Recovery
This release does not migrate any database. Published version tags are immutable; corrections ship as a new patch release.
